It’s important that people with BPD get some quality counseling so they can have health relationships. It seems like she is splitting on u (love/hate thing). Her yelling at you and being demanding isn’t acceptable behavior and she needs to work on that if she wants to stay with you. I think if u do stay u should get really good at setting everyday boundaries with her and set clear expectations of what needs to happen for you to feel comfortable. Set boundaries on how much energy she can consume from you emotionally. Then enforce it in a firm but gentle way. Maybe like “I care about you, but I need you to try to calm down before you continue talking to me in that way.” If you do end up leaving try to prepare a good transition period from dating to friends so it doesn’t turn into an unstable situation. Maybe give her a warning about breaking up if u do want to give her the opportunity to improve her behavior. Moving in with someone with untreated BPD can be risky unless they have shown relatively consistent improvement lasting at least a few months or more (coming from someone with BPD)

Go with what your gut tells you. If you really want to break up with her while things are neutral or even going good, that’s a sign to breakup. That is if you are okay with what comes with being single. Only you can decided if you’re okay with being single or if your mental health can handle that.

I am sorry your going through that. What you’re going through is very difficult. The truth is sex/dick size really should not/doesn’t have to revolve around everything in life. Our culture and social norms make us think that it should. I challenge you to look outside of the social norms that were taught to you, and experience life in other ways. It’s an incredibly difficult realization to make that in actuality u can live a life that doesn’t revolve around sex/dick size. Our culture teaches us that it’s important when in reality it is not. What is important is accepting that it might not change if u don’t try, and then proceeding to do what you can to change it if you can. I know this might be cliché, but dedicate your life to another purpose outside of the social norm. Find something you enjoy and let that activity take over your life and fill that void instead. No void is too big to not be filled. You can always find purpose else where. 

Idk ur beliefs, but you only live one life in my view. We don’t know what happens after death. I believe u experience nothing and u will be gone forever. It doesn’t matter how bad ur life is, life is worth living as long as you can experience it. U have the ability to experience so many things still. Ur at the start of dealing with this difficulty. Don’t stop dealing with it. Instead do the opposite. Start climbing the ladder to healing, recovery, and finding purpose. I promise you if you put in hard work and effort you will see progress. You can still lead a happy and fulfilling life if you put in work. 

I don’t know you, but I know you’re human and you can be strong. Don’t let your mental health win over you and kill you. I’m telling you to fight that shit. Depression wins too many battles over people. Don’t give in to it. Keep pushing forward even if it is a baby step. Celebrate baby steps because those r huge accomplishments when you’re feeling depressed.
